comments: size_defaults: use these values if not provided in the widget definition
widgets: per widget definition, the size is optional (can inherit from size_defaults), hence the internal `width` and `height` properties are again optional
version: related to the version / revision of the layout definition tracked by QuickBoard; essential for rollback to a specific version

per widget, the size.height would be the `same` across the row, hence the largest provided value would win in this case, eg. widget_A-height=small, widget_B-height=large, then height would be `large` for the row
per widget, the sum of size.row MUST be `12` per row
test_only: use this section to test the component registry and rendering logic without the need to create a full layout (to be removed)
